charts.name: Adjacency matrix
charts.question: Which pairs are connected and how strongly, for every pair at once?

charts.name: Alluvial diagram
charts.question: How do groups redistribute across the categories of several ordered variables?

charts.name: Arc diagram
charts.question: Which items in an ordered sequence are linked, and how far apart are the linked ones?

charts.name: Area chart
charts.question: How does the volume of one measure change over time?

charts.name: Bar chart
charts.question: How big is each category, and which is largest?

charts.name: Beeswarm plot
charts.question: Where does every individual sit along one measure, and which ones stand out?

charts.name: Box plot
charts.question: How do the median and spread of a numeric variable compare across groups?

charts.name: Bubble map
charts.question: How much of something is at each place?

charts.name: Bubble chart
charts.question: How do two numeric variables relate, with a third rough magnitude shown by size?

charts.name: Bullet chart
charts.question: How does the actual value compare to its target and to qualitative bands (poor, satisfactory, good)?

charts.name: Bump chart
charts.question: How did the rank order of a set of entities change across several periods?

charts.name: Calendar heatmap
charts.question: Which days, weeks or months were high or low across a year or more?

charts.name: Candlestick chart
charts.question: What were the open, high, low and close of a traded price in each period?

charts.name: Cartogram
charts.question: How big is each region when area stands for a value instead of land?

charts.name: Chord diagram
charts.question: How much flows between each pair in a small set of entities, in both directions, and who are the net winners?

charts.name: Choropleth map
charts.question: How does a rate or ratio vary across regions?

charts.name: Circle packing
charts.question: How does a hierarchy nest, with each node sized by a value, in a picture readers find inviting?

charts.name: Column chart
charts.question: How much was there in each period, and how do the totals compare period to period?

charts.name: Connected scatterplot
charts.question: How did two measures move together over time, and along what path?

charts.name: Correlogram
charts.question: Which pairs among many variables are strongly correlated, positively or negatively?

charts.name: Cycle plot
charts.question: Is there a seasonal pattern, and is each season's level rising or falling across the years (or weeks)?

charts.name: Dendrogram
charts.question: How do items cluster together, and at what distance do the clusters merge?

charts.name: 2D density plot
charts.question: Where do two continuous variables concentrate together, and how many modes does the joint distribution have?

charts.name: Density plot
charts.question: What is the smooth shape of one numeric variable, and how do two or three groups' shapes compare?

charts.name: Diverging bar chart
charts.question: Which categories are above or below a reference (zero, target, average), and by how much?

charts.name: Diverging stacked bar chart
charts.question: How does agreement compare to disagreement across survey items, with the neutral answers centred?

charts.name: Donut chart
charts.question: How big is each slice of one whole, with a headline figure in the centre?

charts.name: Dot density map
charts.question: How is a population or set of events spread across space?

charts.name: Dot plot
charts.question: What is each category's value, and how do a few values per category compare, when the baseline need not be zero?

charts.name: Dumbbell chart
charts.question: How far apart are two values per category, and which way did each move?

charts.name: Cumulative distribution (ECDF)
charts.question: What fraction of values is below x, and how do several distributions compare across their whole range?

charts.name: Hierarchical edge bundling
charts.question: Which parts of a hierarchy are linked to which other parts, and where do the links concentrate?

charts.name: Error bars
charts.question: What is the estimate for each group and how uncertain is it?

charts.name: Flow map
charts.question: How much moves from which place to which place?

charts.name: Funnel chart
charts.question: How much drops out at each stage of a fixed sequence?

charts.name: Gantt chart
charts.question: Which tasks run when, for how long, and which depend on which?

charts.name: Gauge
charts.question: Where does one value sit within a fixed range, shown as a dial?

charts.name: Grouped bar chart
charts.question: How do two or three series compare within each category?

charts.name: Heatmap
charts.question: What is the pattern of a value across two categorical dimensions?

charts.name: Hex map
charts.question: What is the value in each region or cell, on a hexagonal grid that keeps neighbours together?

charts.name: Hexbin plot
charts.question: Where is the mass in a scatter of many thousands of points, and does the relationship still hold under the pile?

charts.name: Histogram
charts.question: What is the shape of one numeric variable: where is it centred, how spread out is it, is it skewed or bimodal?

charts.name: Horizon chart
charts.question: How do dozens of series change over time when each can only have a few pixels of height?

charts.name: Icicle chart
charts.question: How does a hierarchy partition by size at every level, with labels readable at each depth?

charts.name: Line chart
charts.question: How does a value change over time, and how do a few series compare as they change?

charts.name: Lollipop chart
charts.question: How do many categories rank, shown with less ink than bars?

charts.name: Marimekko chart
charts.question: How do shares split by two categorical variables, when the widths also mean the size of each group?

charts.name: Network diagram
charts.question: Who is connected to whom, and what is the structure of the connections?

charts.name: Parallel coordinates
charts.question: How do many entities compare across many quantitative dimensions, and which dimensions move together?

charts.name: Pictogram
charts.question: How many units are there, shown as repeated icons a general audience can count?

charts.name: Pie chart
charts.question: How big is each slice of one whole, and do a few slices together make a majority?

charts.name: Population pyramid
charts.question: How is a population distributed across age bands, and how do two groups (usually sexes) mirror each other?

charts.name: Q-Q plot
charts.question: Does a sample follow a theoretical distribution (usually normal), or the same distribution as another sample?

charts.name: Quadrant chart
charts.question: Which items fall into which of four groups defined by two criteria, such as high impact and low effort?

charts.name: Radar chart
charts.question: What is the profile of one or a few entities across five to ten variables on comparable scales?

charts.name: Radial bar chart
charts.question: How do many categories compare in size, drawn around a circle for compactness or cyclical order?

charts.name: Raincloud plot
charts.question: What is the shape, the summary and every raw value of a numeric variable in each group, all at once?

charts.name: Range band chart
charts.question: What envelope, range or uncertainty surrounds a value as it changes over time?

charts.name: Ridgeline plot
charts.question: How does the shape of a distribution shift across many ordered groups, such as months, years or dose levels?

charts.name: Sankey diagram
charts.question: How do quantities flow from sources to destinations, and where do they end up?

charts.name: Scatter plot
charts.question: Is there a relationship between two numeric variables, and where are the clusters and outliers?

charts.name: Slope chart
charts.question: How did each entity's value or rank change between two points in time?

charts.name: Small multiples
charts.question: How does the same pattern differ across many categories, each shown in its own small panel?

charts.name: Sparkline
charts.question: What is the recent shape of a trend, at a glance, next to the number it belongs to?

charts.name: Scatterplot matrix
charts.question: Which pairs of several numeric variables are related, and what does each variable's distribution look like?

charts.name: Stacked area chart
charts.question: How does a total change over time, and how do its parts contribute?

charts.name: 100% stacked bar chart
charts.question: What share of each whole does every part take, compared across categories?

charts.name: Stacked bar chart
charts.question: How big is each total, and how does it split into a few parts?

charts.name: Stat tile
charts.question: What is the current value, and how has it changed?

charts.name: Step chart
charts.question: When did a level change, and what was it in between?

charts.name: Streamgraph
charts.question: How do many components ebb and flow over time, as an overall picture rather than exact values?

charts.name: Strip plot
charts.question: What are all the values in each category, in the least space?

charts.name: Sunburst chart
charts.question: How does a whole split into nested levels, and what path leads to each leaf?

charts.name: Table
charts.question: What are the exact values, across several measures per row, and where are the patterns?

charts.name: Tile grid map
charts.question: What is the value in each region, giving every region the same visual weight?

charts.name: Timeline
charts.question: When did events happen, in what order, and how long did periods last?

charts.name: Tree diagram
charts.question: What is the structure of a hierarchy, who reports to whom, what contains what?

charts.name: Treemap
charts.question: How does a whole break into nested parts by size, and which parts dominate?

charts.name: Venn diagram
charts.question: Which sets overlap, and roughly how much do they share?

charts.name: Violin plot
charts.question: What is the full shape of a numeric variable in each group, not just its median and spread?

charts.name: Waffle chart
charts.question: What share of the whole, in whole percent, does each part take?

charts.name: Waterfall chart
charts.question: How do successive positive and negative contributions build from a starting total to an ending total?

charts.name: Word cloud
charts.question: Which words or terms appear most often in a body of text?
